summary: Google DeepMind describes a pilot of double-blind AI evaluations using confidential computing to test a Gemini Flash Lite model against confidential benchmarks without either party seeing the other's data.

practices.reason: Describes a novel cryptographic double-blind evaluation methodology that prevents benchmark contamination, which an engineering team could study to assess or design trustworthy third-party evaluations.
practices.quote: By using Confidential Space within Google Cloud’s Confidential Computing portfolio, we can cryptographically verify that both the external evaluation data and the proprietary model remain private to their respective owners.

notable_reason: Introduces a novel cryptographic evaluation method addressing benchmark contamination, a methodology relevant to how the industry verifies model capability claims, even though it carries no direct mechanism transmission.
